deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to Online Store > Themes > Actions > Edit code.
Open the 'templates' folder and locate the 'cart.liquid' file.
Copy and paste the following code into the 'cart.liquid' file, replacing the existing content:

<form id='returns-reason-form' method='post' action='/cart/returns'><label for='returns_reason'>Reason for return:</label><select id='returns_reason' name='returns_reason'><option value=''>Select a reason</option><option value='Defective product'>Defective product</option><option value='Not as described'>Not as described</option><option value='Not needed'>Not needed</option><option value='Other'>Other</option></select><button type='submit'>Submit</button></form>
Save the changes to the 'cart.liquid' file and navigate to your store's cart page to test the returns reason capture form.

To capture the selected reason on your end, you'll need to add a script to your Shopify store. In the Shopify admin panel, navigate to Online Store > Themes > Actions > Edit code, and open the 'theme.liquid' file in the 'layouts' folder.
